title: Plains of Nineveh, Alqosh & Lalish
full_text:
Early morning head to the Plains of Nineveh. Have breakfast with a local Christian family in Bahzani and learn their stories and history.
Visit some of the Yazidi temples in the town.
Head towards Al-Qosh, a Christian town that is home to the tomb of Prophet Nahum.
Visit the astonishing Monastery of Rabban Hormizd, located on top of a mountain.
Head to Lalish and have a unique experience with the Yazidis of Iraq, and learn about their most holy and important land.
